description: This file 'ServiceUtil.java' is a utility class in the 'org.apache.ofbiz.service' package, providing static methods for handling service responses, security checks, error and success message management, date conditions, and other service-related utilities within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling service responses, security, messaging, date conditions, and other service-related functionalities in the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the service results indicate an error based on the response message.

methods.name: isFailure
methods.description: Checks if the service results indicate a failure based on the response message.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Determines if the service results indicate success (not error or failure).

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Creates a result map indicating an error with a message or list.

methods.name: returnFailure
methods.description: Creates a result map indicating a failure with an optional message.

methods.name: returnProblem
methods.description: Constructs a detailed response map including error messages, nested results, and message lists.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Constructs a success response map, optionally with messages.

methods.name: returnMessage
methods.description: Builds a simple message map with response code and message.

methods.name: getPartyIdCheckSecurity
methods.description: Checks security permissions and partyId matching for a user and service operation.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets error and event messages in HttpServletRequest attributes.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves error and success messages from a service result and sets them in request attributes.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Aggregates error messages from a service result map into a single string.

methods.name: makeErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats error messages from result map into a single string with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeSuccessMessage
methods.description: Formats success messages from the result map into a single string with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: makeMessageList
methods.description: Concatenates a list of messages into a single string with optional prefixes and suffixes.

methods.name: addErrors
methods.description: Extracts errors from a call result and adds them to provided list and map targets.

methods.name: genericDateCondition
methods.description: Checks date range conditions and returns a response indicating if the current date falls within the range.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the user login GenericValue, optionally using a runAsUser override.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale from context or default locale.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Builds a Map from variable arguments, expecting key-value pairs where keys are strings.

methods.name: setServiceFields
methods.description: Copies incoming service attributes into a new map, adds userLogin if required, and applies validation.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource name used for localization of messages.
